name: consulting
description: Advice and projects for a business, from someone who knows the field.
howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at the start and releases when what the deal lists is delivered; a big job splits into several escrows, one per stage. A timer to the seller, set past the due date, pays finished work if the buyer goes quiet, and means a buyer who disagrees must settle before it runs out. An arbiter both trust suits a large project. Before paying, write what will be delivered into the deal.
